title: List a 35mm film camera
ask: Please write a listing for my dad's old 35mm film camera. What I know is in item.md and comps.csv has recent sales.
background: It is a manual SLR from the late 1970s with a 50mm lens.
I put a roll through it in February and the photos came out fine, but the light meter reads a stop under.
A dealer called Camera Cellar offered me a trade-in price that I turned down.

constraints.text: price it in dollars, no higher than $240
keep the title on the first line to 50 characters or fewer
say the light meter reads one stop under

start.item.md:
35mm manual SLR, late 1970s, 50mm f/1.8 lens.
Light meter reads one stop under.
Tested with film February 2026.
Postage or pickup: Glebe.
